prompt: A complete desktop website homepage design for 德億茶莊 DEYI TEA HOUSE, a Taiwanese tea house selling its own 杉林溪烏龍茶. Render the web page itself, flat and edge to edge, landscape 16:10 desktop (1440x900 composition). No browser window, no device frame, no desk. STRUCTURE: the page ground is copper orange #C8834B this time, bold, a drenched color field. Top bar in slate teal: left the brand's square carved seal 德億茶莊 2x2 in copper on teal with wordmark 'DEYI TEA HOUSE' in cream (reproduce faithfully from the reference image); right links 茶品 · 產地 · 製茶 · 泡茶 · 門市 and a cream button 'LINE 詢價'. THE DOMINANT MOVE: a giant slate teal tea-shop spec label (a sticker as big as the viewport's left 60%) pasted on the copper ground, ruled in thin cream lines, like an oversized tea-shop price tag. Inside it a 2-column ledger: huge cream headline '杉林溪烏龍茶', then rows 產地 南投竹山・杉林溪, 海拔 1,600m 以上, 季節 春茶／冬茶, 焙度 輕焙, 重量 四兩 150g, and a row '製程' with five numbered cells 採菁 萎凋 炒菁 揉捻 乾燥. A small torn corner of the sticker reveals matte silver foil beneath. On the right 35% of the page, on the copper ground, a single matte foil pack lying on a slight angle, cropped by the page edge, with the copper seal on it, and above it the round primary button '詢價訂購 LINE' as a slate teal rubber-stamp circle with '或來電 0X-XXXX-XXXX' beneath. Bottom fifth: a thin slate teal strip with heading '產地故事' and the beginning of a two-column paragraph in cream at reading size. Traditional Chinese throughout, crisp, body about 16px on a 1440px page. PALETTE: copper, slate teal, foil silver-grey, cream, ink black. No gradients, no glow, no tea-leaf clip art, no brush calligraphy, no awards or certifications.
